clips.title: The story
paras: In eastern Ashenvale, Nightsong Woods runs from Raynewood Retreat toward Azshara. Night elves and the Warsong clan fight over the forest as the Horde harvests lumber, while demonic corruption lingers among its groves.

Nightsong Woods is Ashenvale’s eastern battleground. The Falfarren River cuts through its western reaches, marking a tense boundary between Alliance settlements and Horde incursions. Farther east, Splintertree Post directs Horde campaigns against the Silverwing Sentinels. Warsong orcs fell the southern groves for lumber to fuel the Horde’s expansion, angering the Kaldorei. Satyr strongholds at Satyrnaar and Xavian, along with demonic remnants at Demon Fall Canyon and Felfire Hill, taint the eastern forest.
